## What changed

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change and why it belongs in this pull request.

## Verification

List the exact commands run, their results, and anything that could not be verified.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped; unrelated generated files and formatting are excluded.
- [ ] Public names, paths, schemas, and commands use the Useful identity.
- [ ] Protocol or public-surface changes include matching tests and documentation.
- [ ] Sensitive operations remain explicit and fail closed.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, production configuration, user data, or generated build output is included.
- [ ] I reviewed the applicable license and third-party notice requirements.
